Exercise was a tough mug waiting for me under a flickering streetlamp, all hard angles and bad intentions. But the funny thing about a morning walk or a set of push-ups is they clean the fog out of your head before the city gets a chance to sink its claws in.

## Sweat on the Pavement
A good workout isn’t pretty; it’s a back-alley bargain between you and gravity, and gravity never plays fair. You breathe hard, your muscles sing like a cheap saxophone, and somewhere in that racket your body remembers it was built to survive.

You don’t solve this case in one night, and you don’t build strength in one heroic burst under a bare bulb. You keep showing up, one shadowy mile at a time, until stamina, grit, and habit become your silent partners in a crooked town.
